Daily Transit Brief — Monday, 2026-09-14

Thread URL: https://x.com/ungalsoththu/status/2099342609097322732

Items (last 24h)

  1. [TNSTC] 3,565 special buses to Kilambakkam for post-festival return rush — 2,240 on Sep 14, 1,325 on Sep 15; +160 to Madhavaram, +370 via ECR to Koyambedu; 2.31 lakh passengers left the city over the weekend. — DT Next, Sep 13. https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/3565-special-buses-to-kilambakkam-to-handle-post-festival-rush
  2. [MTC] Kilambakkam festival ops: 508 buses, 47 routes, 2,107 trips; +50 buses (400 trips) evening/night Sep 14, +150 trips early Sep 15; additional buses at Chennai Central, Egmore, Tambaram stations. — DT Next, Sep 13. (same article as #1)
  3. [TNSTC/STU] +38% festival-weekend fleet: 4,629 state buses ran Sep 11–12 vs 3,313 last year (+1,266); Tirunelveli routes +113%, Kumbakonam +71%, Madurai +62%; Villupuram division 2,223 operations (+39%). — PTI via ET CIO Infra, Sep 13. https://infra.economictimes.indiatimes.com/amp/news/urban-transportation/tamil-nadu-sees-38-surge-in-state-bus-services-during-vinayagar-chathurthi-rush/134189809
  4. [Transport] Omni-bus crackdown: 3,512 buses inspected in 3 days, 639 booked, ₹30.77 lakh collected (₹14.39 L compounding + ₹27.58 L tax + ₹3.19 L other fines); fares spiked to ~4x, Madurai last-minute ₹4,000; drive till Sep 16; helpline 9384808333. — The New Indian Express, Sep 14. https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Sep/14/omni-bus-operators-across-tn-fined-rs-31-lakh-for-fleecing-passengers-during-festival-season
  5. [CMDA/Highways] ₹450-crore, 2-km six-lane elevated bridge to replace at-grade Pallavaram–Thoraipakkam Radial Road over Pallikaranai marsh; restores 15,000 cusecs of flood flow to Okkiyam Maduvu; 1.25 lakh vehicles/day use the road; DPR in final touches, ~2 years to build, no land acquisition. — The Hindu, Sep 14. https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/bridge-to-replace-part-of-pallavaram-thoraipakkam-radial-road-on-pallikaranai-marshland/article71463911.ece
  6. [TNSTC] Tenkasi: 24 injured (driver critical) as a govt bus overturned into the Azhagukanni river; police probing phone use, driver fatigue, mechanical fault. — DT Next, Sep 13. https://www.dtnext.in/amp/story/news/tamilnadu/tenkasi-24-injured-as-government-bus-overturns-into-river
  7. [Transport/CAG] CAG audit: 2,008 fancy registration numbers against which ₹1.3 crore VIP fees were charged not remitted to govt; 646 e-payment receipts linked to one mobile number. — DT Next, Sep 14. https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/1-mobile-number-2008-fancy-vehicle-registration-numbers-what-cag-audit-revealed-about-rto-scam-in-tn
